verdict.rationale: Docs confirm API keys let external code 'call the same endpoints the web UI uses' (docs-2) and expose a broad set of endpoints (chat, RAG, memory, functions, gateway API for workspaces) that mirror major UI features, indicating strong intent toward API/UI parity. However, there is no first-party OpenAPI/swagger spec discoverable (probe-2 shows 404s across common paths), and no independent or hands-on confirmation that every UI feature (e.g., voice calls, channels, PWA sync) is fully API-accessible. Missing for 10: a published complete API reference/OpenAPI spec, and independent verification that all UI capabilities map 1:1 to API endpoints.
